title: Reach THE CL*IC SOCCER
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ReachEvent")

local reach = 12

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 60)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -30)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140,140,140)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

local minus = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
minus.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 1, 0)
minus.Text = "-"
minus.TextScaled = true

local plus = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
plus.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 0)
plus.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 1, 0)
plus.Text = "+"
plus.TextScaled = true

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
label.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 0)
label.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.TextScaled = true
label.Text = reach

local function update()
	label.Text = reach
	event:FireServer(reach)
end

minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	reach -= 2
	update()
end)

plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	reach += 2
	update()
end)

update() game.Players.LocalPlayer
